question:

Each employee filled out a profile including three likes or hobbies. On the day of the gift exchange, only eleven gifts were given, each one specific to one of the recipient's interests. Based on the information in the document, who did not give a gift?

```python
from docx import Document

path = "/Data2-v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/cffe0e32-c9a6-4c52-9877-78ceb4aaa9fb.docx"
# Oops, correction:
path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/cffe0e32-c9a6-4c52-9877-78ceb4aaa9fb.docx"

doc = Document(path)

# Extract employees
employees = []
for i in range(2, 14):
    t = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if t:
        employees.append(t)

# Extract profiles
profiles = {}
for i in range(21, 33):
    t = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if ":" in t:
        name, rest = t.split(":", 1)
        profiles[name.strip()] = [x.strip() for x in rest.split(",")]

# Extract gifts
gifts = []
for i in range(36, 47):
    t = doc.paragraphs[i].text.strip()
    if t:
        gifts.append(t)

# Map gifts to interests (best-effort)
gift_interest_map = {
    "Galileo Galilei biography": "Astronomy",
    "Fishing reel": "Fishing",
    "Raku programming guide": "Perl",
    "Chisel set": "Woodworking",
    "Custom dice": "Tabletop RPGs",
    "“War and Peace” American film copy": "Old Movies",
    "Yarn": "Knitting",
    "“One Piece” graphic novel": "Manga",
    "“War and Peace” novel": "Historical Fiction Novels",
    "Starbucks gift card": "Coffee",
    "Foam exercise mat": "Yoga",
}

matched = set()
assignments = {}
for gift, interest in gift_interest_map.items():
    for name, ints in profiles.items():
        if interest in ints:
            matched.add(name)
            assignments[gift] = name
            break

missing = set(employees) - matched
print("Matched recipients:", sorted(list(matched)))
print("Missing recipient:", sorted(list(missing)))
print("Assignments (gift -> recipient):")
for k,v in assignments.items():
    print(k, "->", v)
```
